（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Commandant,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

January 13th 1916

C. I. D.
I. O. REG.
No. 14
Date. 13-1-16

Sir,
It is reported that a Hupeh man named Yoong 熊
a member of the Koh Ming Tang who was displeased with
the action of his party in assassinating Admiral Tseng,
has now turned spy for the Chinese Government.
It is reported that Messrs Pay Dzung Sung 貝润生
and Ling, both prominent members of the Shanghai
Chamber of Commerce, have through fear contributed
$50,000.00 and $30,000.00 respectively to the
funds of the anti-monarchical party.
At 3 p.m. 11th inst a man named Hsu Tuh Sun 許得勝
was shot at and wounded in the arm on the Boulevard
des deux Republiques. The shot is alleged to have been
fired by a Chinese Government detective named Loh
Tsung San 陸春山 . The latter and an accomplice
named Sung Koh Sung 孫克仁 who is also said to be in
the Government detective service are at present in
custody of the French Police. It is reported that
the wounded man is the second of a French detective
and that a quarrel about the division of some bribe
was the cause of the shooting.
Owing to a report received by the Shanghai Military
Authorities that the rebels intend to make trouble
commencing from 12th inst, nobody is allowed on the
streets of the City after 8 p.m.
It is reported that the anti-monarchical party
have succeeded in winning General Feng, Governor of
Kiangsu, to their side, and that he will declare the in-
dependence of his province within a few days.
The Commander of the cruiser Chaoho who has been
detained since that vessel was seized by the rebels
was sent on a warship to Peking yesterday.
It is reported that Liang Chi Tsao 梁起超 does not
intend to leave Shanghai and that he has ordered a
telephone for his house. It is said that Yuan Shih
Kai through some mutual friends has promised to give
him a large sum of money if he will return to Peking
and support the monarchical movement. Liang has
declined the offer.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（左侧手写批注：）
Seen by C.D.
Entered on
ms. Jan. 13.

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探部。）

致上海公共租界工部局总办：

1916年1月13日

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记处
第14号
日期：16-1-13

先生：

据报，一名湖北籍男子熊（Yoong），系“光明党”成员，因不满该党刺杀曾提督之举，现已转而为中国政府充当密探。

据报，上海总商会两位知名会员贝润生（Pay Dzung Sung）先生和林（Ling）先生，因恐惧分别向反君主制党派基金捐款50,000.00美元和30,000.00美元。

本月11日下午3时，一名叫许得胜（Hsu Tuh Sun）的男子在共和路（Boulevard des deux Republiques）遭枪击，手臂受伤。据称开枪者系中国政府侦探陆春山（Loh Tsung San）。后者及其同伙孙克仁（Sung Koh Sung，据称亦供职于政府侦探部门）目前正由法国巡捕房羁押。据报，伤者实为一名法国侦探，枪击起因是双方就分赃不均发生争执。

由于上海军事当局收到报告，称叛乱分子意图自本月12日起制造事端，故每晚8时后禁止任何人进入城内街道。

据报，反君主制党派已成功争取到江苏督军冯将军加入其阵营，预计他将在数日内宣布本省独立。

“巢湖”号巡洋舰指挥官自该舰被叛乱分子扣押以来一直被拘禁，昨日已被送往一艘军舰赴北京。

据报，梁起超（Liang Chi Tsao）不打算离开上海，并已为其住所订购了一部电话。据悉，袁世凯通过一些共同朋友承诺，若梁返回北京并支持君主制运动，将给予其巨额款项。梁已拒绝此提议。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

（左侧手写批注：）
C.D. 阅
录入于
手稿 1月13日。
